hero.headline: Alinea Cloud
hero.text: Alinea Cloud is a hosted backend for the Alinea dashboard. It signs your editors in, stores uploaded media and commits published changes to your GitHub repository, so you don't need to run a database or an auth provider yourself.

items.title: Your editors
items.text: Sign in to your dashboard with their Alinea Cloud account

items.title: Alinea Cloud
items.text: Checks who they are and which role they have

items.title: Your GitHub repo
items.text: Publishing commits the content to your branch as JSON

items.title: Your site
items.text: Picks up the new content, wherever you host it

items.title: Sign-in
items.text: Editors sign in to your dashboard with their Alinea Cloud account. You don’t need a login system of your own.

items.title: Users and roles
items.text: Invite editors from Alinea Cloud and give them one of the roles defined in your config.

items.title: Publishing
items.text: Publishing in the dashboard commits the changes to your GitHub repository.

items.title: Media
items.text: Files uploaded in the dashboard are stored by Alinea Cloud.

items.title: History
items.text: Look back at earlier versions of an entry in the dashboard.

items.title: No lock-in
items.text: Your content stays in your repository, so you can move to a self-hosted backend later without migrating it.

sections.title: How to use it
sections.description: Alinea Cloud connects to an existing Alinea project through a single environment variable.

steps.title: Connect your repository
steps.text: Deploy your site, open its dashboard and choose Continue with alinea.cloud. Connect GitHub and choose the repository your content lives in.

steps.title: Add your API key
steps.text: Set the API key Alinea Cloud gives you as an environment variable on your deployment and redeploy.

steps.title: Invite your editors
steps.text: Invite them from Alinea Cloud. They sign in on your dashboard with their own account.

sections.title: Free while in beta
sections.text: Alinea Cloud is in beta and free to use while it is.

items.question: Do I need Alinea Cloud to use Alinea?

content.text: No. Alinea only needs a Node.js environment and a git repository. For editors to sign in and publish on your deployed site you need a backend: you can run one yourself on your own database, or use Alinea Cloud.

items.question: Does Alinea Cloud host my website?

content.text: No. Your website and dashboard stay hosted by you, wherever you deploy them today. Alinea Cloud handles sign-in, users, media uploads and publishing to your GitHub repository.

items.question: What happens to my content if I stop using it?

content.text: Your published content lives in your own repository, so it stays yours. You can switch to running your own backend instead at any time.

items.question: Is Alinea Cloud used during local development?

content.text: No. When you run alinea dev, changes are saved to the files on your machine.

metadata.description: Alinea Cloud is a hosted backend for Alinea: sign-in for your editors, users and roles, media storage and publishing to your GitHub repository.
